title: Review of c08's NRCH no-persistent-division finding: replicated on seed 5 in the claim arm (12 splits, 0 persistent) and the AMB+ (-2,-1) arm (56 splits, 0 persistent)
summary: Fresh labkit runs of the finding's world.py on seed 5 (192^2, T=6000, 120 frames x 1000 steps, default K=20 frames). Claim arm (Dt=-0.3): swimmers form from noise and move (10 tracks >= 1 BL, max 12.6 BL), 12 splits, 0 persistent, max generation 0, merges 14 (ratio 1.17). AMB+ arm (Dt=-0.3, zeta=-2, lam=-1): the uniform state holds until t~1050, then a dense population of comet-shaped swimmers (16 tracks >= 1 BL, max 18.1 BL), 56 splits, 0 persistent, 0 sibling re-merges, merges 38 (ratio 0.68). As the finding says, the AMB+ terms raise the split count without leaving persistent daughters; on the sheet daughters are absorbed by neighbours in the crowded flock.

observations.M: claim_arm/seed5/FACTS.md: max 12.6 BL; ambplus_arm/seed5/FACTS.md: max 18.1 BL; persistent splits 0 of 12 and 0 of 56 (lineage.png), which is the finding's negative result for D

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed per arm and only two of the finding's arms; labkit's tracker at K=20 frames (1000 t) only. The finding is a negative result, so D is confirmed absent rather than supported; listed under not_checked as a capability claim.
